TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANT TOSECTION93-32 OFTHEZONINGRESOLUTIONOFTHECITYOFNEWYORK This Transfer and Distribution of Development Rights Instrument ("Transfer and Distribution Instrument") is made as of the 2a day of Jo↓4, 2015, by and between Mid-town Development Limited Partnership, a New York limited partnership, with an address c/o Philips Nizer LLP, 666 Fifth Avenue, New York NY 10103 ("Transferor"), and 509 W 34, L.L.C., a Delaware limited liability company, with an office c/o Tishman Speyer, Rockefeller Center, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111 ("Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, pursuant to Sections 93-21(a) and 93-32(a) of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter,the “Zoning Resolution"), the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission of the City of New York (the “CPC" Chairperson') shall allow, by certification, the distribution of Floor Area that is generated by a “granting site" located in the Phase 2 Hudson Park and Boulevard (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution) to a “receiving site” located in Subarea A2 through A5 of Large Scale Plan Subdistrict A of the Special Hudson Yards District (as such terms are defined in the Zoning Resolution), which distribution of floor area shall not exceed a maximum of eight (8) Floor Area Ratio ("FAR") on such receiving site; and WHEREAS, Transferor is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 708, Lot 1 on the Tax Map of New York, a portion of which is located in the Phase 2 Hudson Boulevard and Park of the Special Hudson Yards District, such portion as more particularly described in Exhibit  I attached hereto and made a part hereof (the "Granting Site"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the fee owner of that certain real property located in the County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 706, Lots 17, 20 and 29 on the Tax Map of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit HI attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Receiving Site"); and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is located partially in a C6-4 zoning district and partially in a C6-2 zoning district and is located entirely in the Phase 2 Hudson Park and Boulevard of the Special Hudson Yards District; and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is a “granting site," as defined in Section 93-32 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, the Granting Site has a lot area of twenty-three thousand three hundred seventy-eight and eight hundredths (23,378.08) square feet, of which eighteen thousand four hundred nine and thirty-seven hundredths (18,409.37) square feet is located in the underlying C6-2 zoning district and four thousand nine hundred sixty-eight and seventy-one hundredths (4,968.71 square) feet is located in the underlying C6-4 zoning district;
